scope: The existing G2 generated Rust/Wasm Host, Web ingress and event Runner. This manifest does not add a router, database driver, credential, or production deployment configuration.

cases.evidence: generated G2 Rust/Wasm trap_probe() abandons the Runner generation
real ReadableStream body crosses the existing HTTP ingress read deadline and a healthy G2 request follows
event-owned Host callback is fenced, bounded cleanup remains owner-owned, and fresh generated Wasm recovers
an opaque Auth-style callback crosses a real workerd service binding and normalizes failure/timeout without exposing endpoint identity
the existing W02 matrix holds stream/WebSocket sessions while short requests rotate in separate profile domains

doesNotProve: deployed Worker routing or deployment configuration
production capacity, CPU, memory, fleet, SLO, or resource isolation

externalReceipts.required: A versioned Auth candidate or explicit source snapshot must execute OAuth create/consume/revoke through workers_postgres_factory(execute) using this Host callback seam. Run auth-postgres-cohort.mjs with the Auth source and its actual local-workerd cohort command; the receipt records candidate/source identity and the no-binding/no-secret factory contract without credentials or binding name.

A task-owned deployed Worker and real D1 binding must fail a real Auth persistence operation, produce a bounded failure receipt, and prove a clean healthy follow-up. Local service bindings and mocked D1 objects do not satisfy this gate.

An external client must abort a streaming response and the same-isolate receipt must show request.signal.aborted, cancelled Kernel work, and clean shutdown. Response-write failure alone does not satisfy this gate.

A task-owned deployed Worker must use a real Hyperdrive-backed PostgreSQL connection through the Host callback, exercise failure/timeout/cancellation plus uncertain mutation handling, and prove that no retry occurs after an ambiguous durable write. A callback service fixture does not satisfy this gate.

receiptSchema.credentials: Receipts must not contain connection strings, binding names, secrets, private URLs, Auth bodies, tokens, or PII.

classification: Miniflare is not local workerd evidence.
local workerd proves only the local-workerd cases above.
A deployed Worker receipt proves only its task-owned deployed configuration.
Production deployment remains a separate rollout, observability, budget, and operations qualification.
